svg.aria-label: Chronoamperometry setup: pre-step 0 V for 30 s; step 1 at 0.100 V for 2 to 10 hours; step 2 at 0 V for the same time as step 1; sample period 5 to 10 s; range Auto; area 1 cm²; vs Eref only for SS cells that store no charge.
